from pathlib import Path
src='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    color=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,1))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0]); mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for r in range(H-mh+1):
      for c in range(W-mw+1):
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==1 for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
'''

# redefine transformation all dihedral variants
src='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    color=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,1))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    variants=set()
    for flip in (1,-1):
      for k in range(4):
        q=[]
        for r,c in shape:
          x,y=r,c*flip
          for _ in range(k): x,y=y,-x
          q.append((x,y))
        mr=min(x for x,y in q); mc=min(y for x,y in q)
        variants.add(frozenset((x-mr,y-mc) for x,y in q))
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    for sh in variants:
      mh=max(r for r,c in sh)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in sh)+1
      for r in range(H-mh+1):
       for c in range(W-mw+1):
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==1 for dr,dc in sh):
         for dr,dc in sh: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
'''
Path('programs/task-7ea8a0e9.py').write_text(src)
